as_told.title: Reinhold Schmidt describes the saucer interior

plain: Jason Jorjani, a researcher who argues that Nazi Germany had a secret flying saucer programme, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about a man named Reinhold Schmidt in Nebraska in 1957. According to Jorjani, Schmidt claimed he met the crew of a landed saucer and realised they were speaking High German, the standard form of German, to each other. In an old recording played on the show, Schmidt himself describes the craft as one solid piece of something like aluminium or highly polished steel. If true, Jorjani suggests, it would point to the saucers being human machines with German roots rather than visitors from elsewhere.
